career_ladder.note: Artisans and ITI Trade Trainees in Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) advance through the manufacturing shop floor workman hierarchy based on plant trade tests, service seniority, and wage agreement revisions.

steps.designation: Artisan / ITI Trade Trainee (Welder / Fitter / Electrician / Machinist)
steps.source_label: BHEL Artisan Recruitment Advertisement and Wage Revision Agreement
BHEL Workman Cadre Rules (Regularization upon training completion)

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment selection consists of a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a Trade / Skill Test. The written CBT carries 150 questions testing vocational trade curriculum and general aptitude. The trade test is qualifying in nature.

stages.source_label: BHEL Artisan Examination Scheme and Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Part A: NCVT ITI Trade Domain Knowledge (Welder / Fitter / Electrician / Machinist / Turner)
Part B: General Knowledge, General English, Basic Mathematics & Reasoning

stages.stage_name: Trade / Skill Test (Practical Shop Floor Evaluation)

papers.paper_name: Practical Trade Test on Work Bench / Machine Tool
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying in nature (shortlisted at 1:3 ratio from CBT)

financial_package.note: Wages are fixed in accordance with BHEL bipartite workman wage revision settlement. Artisans enter in Wage Grade W-IV with starting basic pay ₹29,500, mandatory 58% DA constant as of 2025-07-01, plant township housing, and manufacturing allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: BHEL Workman Wage Agreement and Notification
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated based on Entry Basic Pay ₹29,500, 58% IDA (₹17,110), Plant Allowance, HRA (9%–18%) or BHEL Township housing (Trichy / Haridwar / Bhopal / Hyderabad), less statutory Provident Fund (12% Basic+DA) and ESIC/medical deductions.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) revised quarterly per AICPI
Free / Subsidized Company Township Quarters in BHEL industrial townships
Plant Workman Allowances and Shift Allowance for factory shifts
Plant Performance Incentive / Production Bonus Scheme
Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, and Group Term Insurance
Comprehensive in-house hospital medical treatment at BHEL Main Hospital for employee and family
